title: Category name, QuickBooks item and Tax Exempt save as soon as changed
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, with Tax Exempt off.
  • Use a client connected to QuickBooks.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings › Categories.
  2. Click category A's row.
  3. Click the category name at the top of the page.
  4. Type a new name no other category uses.
  5. Press Enter.
  6. Tick Tax Exempt.
  7. Pick another item in QuickBooks Products and Services.
  8. Reload the page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Category A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Category A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The name becomes editable in place.

Step 4:

  • The new name shows in the field.

Step 5:

  • The title shows the new name; no Save button is needed.

Step 6:

  • Tax Exempt is ticked.

Step 7:

  • The new item shows in QuickBooks Products and Services.

Step 8:

  • After the reload the page shows the new name, Tax Exempt ticked and the new QuickBooks item.
